lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill region; spot diameter decreases and density increases towards the ventral-anterior quadrant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with spot clusters to form a coordinate-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance edge on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin; patterning appears less organized compared to the lateral flank.
